title.zh: 将哥打巴托省 President Roxas 市镇 Kamasi 描笼涯的总统 Roxas 国立中学的 Kamasi 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the President Roxas National High School - Kamasi Annex in Barangay Kamasi, Municipality of President Roxas, Province of Cotabato From the President Roxas National High School and Converting the Same Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Kamasi National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the President Roxas National High School - Kamasi Annex in Barangay Kamasi, Municipality of President Roxas, Province of Cotabato From the President Roxas National High School and Converting the Same Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Kamasi National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Kamasi của Trường Trung học President Roxas Quốc gia tại Barangay Kamasi, Đô thị President Roxas, Tỉnh Cotabato khỏi Trường Trung học President Roxas Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Kamasi Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Kamasi ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา President Roxas แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Kamasi เทศบาล President Roxas จังหวัด Cotabato ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา President Roxas แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Kamasi แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Kamasi, Sekolah Menengah President Roxas Nasional di Barangay Kamasi, Kotamadya President Roxas, Provinsi Cotabato dari Sekolah Menengah President Roxas Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Kamasi Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Kamasi, Sekolah Menengah President Roxas Kebangsaan di Barangay Kamasi, Perbandaran President Roxas, Wilayah Cotabato daripada Sekolah Menengah President Roxas Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Kamasi Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The President Roxas National High School - Kamasi Annex in Barangay Kamasi, Municipality of President Roxas, Province of Cotabato is hereby separated from the President Roxas National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Kamasi National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
All personnel, records, assets and liabilities of the President Roxas National High School - Kamasi Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Kamasi National High School.

The amount necessary for the initial implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the President Roxas National High School - Kamasi Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continuous operation and maintenance of the Kamasi National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
